subject: How to get bars in ggplot2 as grob??

messages.author: ae61b6b8911d6ad3
messages.subject: How to get bars in ggplot2 as grob??
parts:
for example:

library(ggplot2)

width = 0.5
lala <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = factor(cyl), y = mpg, fill = factor(cyl))) +
    geom_bar(stat = "summary",
             stat_params = list(fun.y = mean),
             geom_params = list(width = width, color = "black")) +
    geom_errorbar(stat = "summary",
                  stat_params = list(fun.y = mean,
                      fun.ymax = function(x) mean(x) + sd(x),
                      fun.ymin = function(x) mean(x) - sd(x)),
                  geom_params = list(width = width * 0.8, color = "black")) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim=c(0,50))


Q: then i want to add p-values to barplot, but i have to get bar heights.
       After using ggplotGrob(lala), i have no idea what can i do next to get bars as grobs??


Any suggestion is appreciated
Thanks


Regards, Meng Zhao
